timeline.title: A Short History of Pets Being in Charge
items: Friends from the start
In Cyprus, a cat was buried beside a person. It is one of the oldest signs of a much loved pet.
Ancient Egypt
Pets in high places
Egyptians adored their cats and dogs, gave them names and treated them as part of the family.
Ancient Rome
Beware of the dog
Romans set Cave Canem mosaics at their front doors. Pets have been running the house ever since.
A promise to protect
The world's first animal welfare charity was founded in London, so pets everywhere would be cared for.
today: Not in the history books yet. But to us, the most famous pet who ever lived.

items: Animals are such agreeable friends: they ask no questions, they pass no criticisms.
George Eliot, Scenes of Clerical Life
Happiness is a warm puppy.
Charles M. Schulz, Peanuts
The love for all living creatures is the most noble attribute of man.
Charles Darwin, The Descent of Man, 1871

An old English proverb
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. We just say: who is a good one? You are, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of How Pets Love Us
items: heart
The love hormone
When a dog and its human gaze at each other, oxytocin, the bonding hormone, rises in both.
eye
The slow blink
A slow blink from a cat is a sign of trust. Blink slowly back and they often return it.
paw
Your smell is special
In brain scans, the scent of their own human lit up the reward centre of a dog's brain.
music
They know your voice
Cats and dogs can pick out their own human's voice from the voices of strangers.
pulse
Instant calm
Stroking a calm, much loved pet can lower stress and help a racing heart slow down.
home
The waiting game
Many pets learn our routines and wait by the door around the time we usually come home.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It still cannot explain how {who} hears a snack open from upstairs.

note.title: What we believe a pet is
paras: We make magazines for a living, and we will admit it: this is one of our favourites.
We believe a pet is not just an animal in the house. A pet is the welcome at the door, the warm weight at your feet, the face that says you are the best person in the world, even on your worst day.
{who}, someone thinks you deserve to be a cover star. Not a card anyone could buy, but pages full of you: your crimes, your talents, your very serious naps.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, you are loved more than all the treats in the world.
note.wish: Thank you, {who}. Good pet. The very best.
